tools.name: verdict_status
tools.description: Read current readiness and decision-only service identity. Configuration readiness is not proof of a fresh Jev evaluation or settlement. No model, wallet or trade call.

tools.name: verdict_contract
tools.description: Read the live Verdict Protocol OpenAPI contract and separate paid HTTP service requirements. This tool never calls /decide or /seal and cannot authorize payments or forward keys.

tools.name: verdict_compile_capsule
tools.description: Freeze caller-supplied research state into a timestamped SHA256 capsule using the production compiler. Stateless: no persistence, Jev call, signature, paid receipt, trade approval or settlement. The timestamp changes each compilation.

tools.name: verdict_verify_capsule
tools.description: Recompute the hash of a supplied frozen capsule. A matching hash proves internal integrity only, not source truth, SML issuance, receipt authenticity, Jev execution or payment. No model or wallet call.

tools.name: verdict_review_jury
tools.description: Validate five uniquely identified caller-supplied juror votes and recompute the production jury aggregation. No new Jev evaluation occurs. The report is untrusted input: aggregation does not authenticate issuance, correctness, independence, trade approval or payment.

tools.name: verdict_decide
tools.description: Invoke the existing /decide service: five Jev jurors over a frozen capsule, with persisted signed receipt. Without payment returns the fresh x402 challenge.
